verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־ אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ ’ĕlō·hîm niṣ·ṣāḇ ba·‘ă·ḏaṯ- ’êl bə·qe·reḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm yiš·pōṭ
verses.literal: A Psalm of Asaph God presides in the divine assembly He renders judgment among the gods
verses.literalPt: Deus assiste na congregação de Deus, no meio dos deuses, julga ele.

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־ עָ֑וֶל וּפְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ־ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay tiš·pə·ṭū- ‘ā·wel ū·p̄ə·nê rə·šā·‘îm tiś·’ū- se·lāh
verses.literal: How long . . . will you judge unjustly and show partiality . . . to the wicked Selah
verses.literalPt: Até quando julgareis injustamente e tereis respeito às pessoas dos perversos? (Selá)

verses.original: שִׁפְטוּ־ דַ֥ל וְיָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָרָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ׃
verses.literal: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed
verses.literalPt: Fazei justiça ao fraco e ao órfão, procedei retamente com o aflito e o desamparado.

verses.original: פַּלְּטוּ־ דַ֥ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים הַצִּֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: pal·lə·ṭū- ḏal wə·’eḇ·yō·wn mî·yaḏ rə·šā·‘îm haṣ·ṣî·lū
verses.literal: Rescue the weak and needy save them from the hand of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Livrai o fraco e o necessitado, salvai-o da mão dos perversos.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ׀ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל־ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yā·ḏə·‘ū wə·lō yā·ḇî·nū ba·ḥă·šê·ḵāh yiṯ·hal·lā·ḵū yim·mō·w·ṭū kāl- mō·ws·ḏê ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They do not know . . . or understand they wander in the darkness all the foundations of the earth are shaken
verses.literalPt: Eles não sabem, nem entendem; andam vagueando às escuras; estão abalados todos os fundamentos da terra.

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: I have said You are gods you are all sons of the Most High
verses.literalPt: Eu disse: Vós sois deuses; e todos vós, filhos do Altíssimo.

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.literal: But like mortals you will die and like rulers you will fall
verses.literalPt: Todavia, como homens, haveis de morrer e, como qualquer dos príncipes, haveis de sucumbir.

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh ’ĕ·lō·hîm šā·p̄ə·ṭāh hā·’ā·reṣ kî- ’at·tāh ṯin·ḥal bə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Arise O God judge the earth for all the nations are Your inheritance
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, ó Deus, julga a terra, pois tu herdarás todas as nações.
